title: Is Now a Good Time to Start Investing?
summary: There is no reliable all-clear signal. Decide using your goal, horizon, cash needs and risk capacity—not a prediction about this week's market.
body_markdown:
## Sources and further reading


Checked July 16, 2026. Community posts and videos are included as perspectives; official sources carry the factual authority.


1. [Introduction to Investing](https://www.investor.gov/introduction-investing)


Investor.gov · government


Goals, time horizon, regular investing, diversification, emergency savings, and high-interest debt.


2. [Asset Allocation and Diversification](https://www.investor.gov/introduction-investing/getting-started/asset-allocation)


Investor.gov · government


Time horizon, risk tolerance, diversification, rebalancing, and limits of narrowly focused funds.


3. [Dollar Cost Averaging](https://www.investor.gov/introduction-investing/investing-basics/glossary/dollar-cost-averaging)


Investor.gov · government


Definition of investing equal portions at regular intervals through market changes.


4. [The Pros and Cons of Dollar-Cost Averaging](https://www.finra.org/investors/insights/dollar-cost-averaging)


FINRA · regulator


Behavioral benefits and the opportunity cost of leaving a lump sum in cash longer.


5. [The Best Time to Invest](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3i0xitaOOps)


PBS Two Cents · video


Transcript reviewed for market-timing behavior and long-horizon framing.


6. [How Risky Is the Stock Market?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=249Gc7FDWRI)


PBS Two Cents · video


Transcript reviewed for volatility, loss, horizon, and risk framing.
